text:
Cloudflare built in yet, but your Grok Bot can do it. Paste this into it:

"Install the Grokbot Mail template (https://x.ai/bot/vHWtUqHtdpfhnwTFOfEVT) and follow its setup, but host it on Cloudflare Workers instead of Vercel. Use the repo http://github.com/PhillipHolland/mail.grokbot, build with nitro's cloudflare_module preset, use a Neon database through a Workers-compatible driver, and set the GBM_* secrets with wrangler secret put. Ask me before anything that needs my Cloudflare login." ☁️
